recipe.title: Sardine linguine
ingredients: 1 tin sardines or mackerel, drained (or 300 g cleaned mussels)
steps: Cook pasta in salted water and reserve a little cooking liquid.
Warm oil and garlic, then soften tomatoes in a pan.
Add fish and warm through, or cook mussels until opened; discard unopened mussels.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice and parsley; loosen with pasta water.

recipe.title: Simple caponata
ingredients: 400 g main ingredient named in the title
steps: Prepare and cut the main ingredient into evenly sized pieces.
Heat oil and soften the onion and garlic.
Add the main ingredient, stock and spices.
Cook until tender and safely cooked through; adjust seasoning and serve.

recipe.title: Simple arrabbiata
ingredients: 1 small courgette or bell pepper, diced
steps: Cook pasta according to the package directions; drain.
Heat oil, sauté garlic and vegetables until softened.
Add tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Combine sauce with pasta; season and serve.

recipe.title: Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 300 g boneless chicken or turkey, diced
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Sauté poultry in oil until fully cooked.
Add garlic, tomatoes and basil; simmer 8 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta, season and serve.

recipe.title: Brilliant Bolognese
steps: Heat oil and cook onion for 3 minutes; add garlic.
Add beef and cook until browned and fully cooked.
Stir in tomatoes and oregano; simmer 15–20 minutes.

recipe.title: Sticky orange chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (392°F).
Mix oil, garlic, spices, lemon and seasoning.
Coat chicken and place on a baking tray.
Roast until chicken reaches 74°C (165°F) internally, about 25–35 minutes depending on cut.

recipe.title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 700 g beef or lamb (matching the recipe title)
steps: Heat oven to 160°C (320°F) for a slow braise.
Brown meat in oil, then transfer to a lidded baking dish.
Add vegetables, stock and seasonings; cover tightly.
Cook until the cut is tender, checking liquid occasionally; timing varies by cut.

recipe.title: Vanilla-Infused Panna Cotta with Pomegranate Glaze
steps: Bloom gelatin in cold water according to package directions.
Warm cream, milk, sugar and vanilla without boiling.
Dissolve bloomed gelatin into warm mixture.
Pour into ramekins and refrigerate until set, about 4 hours.

Sauté onion in oil until soft; remove from pan.

recipe.title: Smoky Mountain Cheesy Crawfish Omelette
steps: Pat fish dry and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat.
Cook fish until opaque and it flakes easily; use safe internal temperature guidance.
Finish with garlic, lemon and parsley; serve.

recipe.title: Michigan French Toast Sandwich
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F) and prepare a baking pan or muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, milk, oil, sugar and vanilla.
Fold in flour and baking powder until just combined.
Bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean; cool before serving.
